1:
find /sys/class/net/*/device/driver/module/drivers -maxdepth 1 -path "*e1000e*" | \
awk -F'/' '{print $5}' | \
xargs -I% nsenter --net=/host/proc/$(pidof /usr/local/bin/kubelet)/ns/net \
                  -- sh -c "
                    echo '% - BEFORE' && \
                    echo '==========' && \
                    ethtool -k % && \
                    echo '==========' && \
                    echo 'Disabling offloads for %...' && \
                    ethtool -K % tso off && \
                    echo '==========' && \
                    echo '% - AFTER' && \
                    echo '==========' && \
                    ethtool -k % && \
                    echo '=========='
                  " && \
sleep infinity
